messages.content:
The comments of one conversation have been grouped into topics, in layers. Layer 0 holds the narrowest topics; each higher layer holds broader topics, and a topic's parent is the broader topic in the layer above that contains it. Below, every topic is listed, broadest layer first, with its id, its layer, its parent's id, its number of comments, its five keywords and up to three sample comments.

Give every topic a short name (3–5 words) that says what its comments are about. Name each topic exactly once, by its id. No two topics may share a name.
